## DEEP OROPHARYNGEAL INFECTIONS
Deep oropharyngeal infections may threaten life and must be treated immediately.
Assess the risk of airway compromise and monitor the airway if it is threatened.
These infections are more common in people with diabetes mellitus and are caused
by mixed organisms including streptococcus sp., Staphylococcus aureus and
anaerobes . Perform CT scan to diagnose abscess. ENT and Infectious Diseases
consults are essential.
## Duration of therapy
If the patient's condition worsens or does not improve during the first 48 hours
of antimicrobial therapy, surgical drainage is indicated. If surgical drainage
is done, antimicrobials are usually continued for 48 hours after the procedure.
If surgical drainage is not done, 2 weeks of antimicrobial therapy until
clinical improvement is observed (e.g. resolution of fever and leukocytosis) is
appropriate.
## Empiric Treatment
## Inpatient

Preferred:
[Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q6h for 7 days ($) [R]](psjizid-ampicillin-sulbactam-3gm-iv-q6h)
Alternative: [Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h ($) [DI]](orz-set-abx-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h-metron-500mg-iv-q8h)
## Risk factors for MRSA or gram-positive cocci in clusters on gram stain, in
## addition to one of the above antimicrobial regimens
[< ADD > vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12 hours ($) [R]](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)
## Immunocompromised patient or severe infection
Immunocompromised patients require additional coverage for Staphylococcus aureus
and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
Preferred:
< AND > vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
Alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
[Cefepime 2 gm IV q12h ($$) [R] < AND > vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q 12 hours ($) [R]](orz-set-abx-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q12h-vanco-15mg-kg-q12h)
for 7 days
## Step-down treatment after initial intravenous therapy. Adjust duration based on
## criteria above.
[Amoxicillin/clavulanate 875-125 mg PO q12h for 7 days ($) [R]](psjzid-amox-clav-875-125mg-po-q12h)
